description:
A Sales Manager is finalizing a Quarterly Business Review presentation. Slide 2 of the file '/home/ga/Documents/Presentations/quarterly_review.odp' (currently open in LibreOffice Impress) contains five colored rectangles representing product tiers: Starter, Basic, Pro, Enterprise, and Ultimate. These shapes currently have no visual depth.

Add a visible drop shadow to ALL FIVE rectangle shapes on Slide 2 to give them a professional 'floating card' appearance. Use a black shadow color. The shadow should be clearly visible (any reasonable offset/distance is acceptable).

After applying shadows to all 5 shapes, save the file with Ctrl+S (keep the same filename and ODP format).

Do NOT delete, rename, or reorder any slides. Do NOT change the text content within the shapes.
